论文题名: Modeling nonlinear ultrasound propagation in heterogeneous media with power law absorption using a k-space pseudospectral method

论文题名: A rapid beam simulation framework for transcranial focused ultrasound

论文题名: An open-source phase correction toolkit for transcranial focused ultrasound

论文题名: Transcranial focused ultrasound modulates the activity of primary somatosensory cortex in humans
